generation.intent: new independently generated fan-art; reference screenshot is style only
generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for an independent Windows desktop companion.
Primary request: Create a production-ready 3 by 3 atlas, nine evenly spaced full-body sprites of Nino Nakano from The Quintessential Quintuplets, the short pink-haired season-two version. This is new unofficial fan art. The earlier desktop-pet gallery screenshot is a STYLE reference only, not an edit target, and do not reproduce any gallery character.
Subject identity: compact super-deformed chibi Nino, about 2.6 heads tall, rose-pink straight bob/shoulder-length hair with blunt bangs and longer side locks; two unmistakable black butterfly hair ribbons with cyan-blue wing accents, one on each side; large sapphire-blue eyes; small sweet confident mouth. White buttoned blouse, open black long cardigan, simple bright leaf-green pleated skirt, opaque white over-knee socks, black loafers. Both feet grounded, relaxed arms at sides with tiny hands, body front-facing, one coherent design.
Style: authentic low-resolution videogame pixel art like a carefully hand-pixeled desktop mascot; crisp visible stair-step silhouette, chunky square pixel clusters, dark plum 1 to 2 logical pixel outline, simple cel-shaded limited palette, charming readable face. Large head, tiny limbs. It should read as a real pixel sprite at 160 pixels tall, not a smooth anime illustration. No gradients, blur, painted texture, glossy rendering or fine anti-aliased line work.
Composition: exact 3-column by 3-row grid on a square canvas. Nine equal square cells, no gutters, no separators, no borders, no labels. Each cell contains exactly one full-body sprite. Center the exact same body silhouette horizontally in every cell, with feet on the same local baseline at 90% of the cell height and hair top at 10%. Sprite must fit with generous transparent space at every edge; butterflies never cross cell boundaries. Keep hair, costume, body size, pose, hands, feet and ground position identical across all nine frames; facial expression alone changes.
Frame order left to right, top to bottom:
1 neutral idle: open blue eyes, tiny friendly closed smile, relaxed brows, attentive and composed, NOT angry.
2 blinking: both eyes gently closed, same tiny smile, same face and body.
3 talking-small: open blue eyes, small open speaking mouth.
4 talking-open: open blue eyes, larger open speaking mouth, friendly conversational face.
5 happy: joyful crescent closed eyes, small beaming open smile.
6 mildly annoyed: small pout, slightly lowered brows, restrained tsundere displeasure, NOT furious or violent.
7 shy: blue eyes glancing slightly aside, visibly rosy cheeks, bashful tiny smile.
8 surprised: wide blue eyes, small round O mouth, raised brows.
9 sad: softened blue eyes, gently worried brows, small downturned mouth, quiet sadness, no tears or effects.
Background: actual fully transparent alpha. Only the nine character sprites are opaque.
Constraints: no writing, no numbers, no watermark, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard drawn into image, no detached hearts/stars/speech icons, no extra accessories, no extra characters, no motion streaks. Each sprite is a clean separate cutout.

design_choice.character: Nino Nakano / 中野二乃, The Quintessential Quintuplets
identity: black butterfly ribbons with cyan-blue accents
design_choice.default_expression: attentive, softly confident, small friendly smile; displeasure is one optional expression
design_choice.style: pixel-art-adjacent chibi fan-art draft; generated edges retain source alpha

references.role: character identity; observed image only, no pixels used in final art
gallery screenshot style only; no character or pixel reuse
image/behavior separation methodology; no VPet art reused
per-frame duration and grounded anchor methodology; no Shimeji art reused

operations: Select nine generated sprite regions by observed actual geometry
Translate integer pixels into 384x448 transparent frame with alpha128 visible baseline y=432
Pack frames row-major into 3x3 PNG atlas

limitations: Art is a generated first draft, not an official asset or a commissioned hand-pixelled production sprite.
All expressions share a frontal standing pose; there are no walking or directional animation frames.
Thinking and listening intentionally reuse idle/blink.
Speaking has two mouth drawings on a timed loop, not phoneme-accurate lip sync.
Minor generated hair/body texture variation between expressions remains; alpha pixels are preserved.
